## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `dddbca3f5f00028a578a69839a8e90866c9068f4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/core/src/actions/index.ts, ui/packages/core/src/index.ts + ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionEngine.ts, ui/packages/core/src/utils/freeze-schema.ts, ui/packages/core/package.json (exports map), ui/packages/core/README.md, packages/qa/dogfood/test/organization-rename-door.dogfood.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts, the four `function deepFreeze` test files under packages/** (plugin-security, service-analytics ×2, spec)

Rendered 2026-11-08T03:33Z on PR #31348 (card #25921, batch 15: claim 6716004841, amendment 6716057610 at 2026-11-08T02:15Z). Net diff against `main` (merge base `604a2b3b`): 3 files, +45/−2; the two code hunks each turn one `export *` line into a named list, the third file is the changeset. Every absence claim below was re-measured by this review on `origin/main` (`dc7f5c4b`, fetched for this record) and on hotcrm `6961ab1`, by `git grep -w` over the whole tree; the PR body's account was not relied on.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set / public-surface change implied by the diff: exactly two names leave the `@object-ui/core` root entry, `RegisteredAction` (type) and `deepFreeze` (value), nothing else — right.** Read in the cited modules at the head: `actions/ActionEngine.ts` exports five names (`ActionLocation` type re-export, `ACTION_LOCATIONS` value re-export, `RegisteredAction`, `ShortcutBinding`, `ActionEngine`); the new named list carries `ActionEngine`, `ACTION_LOCATIONS`, `type ActionLocation`, `type ShortcutBinding`, so the only name dropped is `RegisteredAction`. `utils/freeze-schema.ts` exports eight names (`SYSTEM_VIEW_MARKER`, `DeepReadonly`, `DeepMutable`, `SystemView`, `deepFreeze`, `defineSystemView`, `isSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride`); the new list carries the other seven with the right `type` modifiers (`DeepReadonly`, `DeepMutable`, `SystemView` are `export type`; `SYSTEM_VIEW_MARKER` is a `const`; in `@object-ui/types` `ActionLocation` is `export type` and `ACTION_LOCATIONS` a value), so the only name dropped is `deepFreeze`. No type-only export is lost by accident.
- **No second route to either name — right.** `src/index.ts` reaches `ActionEngine.ts` only through `export * from './actions/index.js'` (line 156) and `freeze-schema.ts` only through the edited line; no other file under `ui/packages/core/src` re-exports either module (the only other mentions are two in-package tests importing by module path). `package.json` publishes one entry, `.`, so there is no subpath that still carries them. No published package star-exports `@object-ui/core` (zero hits for `export * from '@object-ui/core'`), so no sibling entry narrows as a side effect.
- **Zero consumers through the barrel — right, re-measured.** `git grep -w RegisteredAction origin/main -- .` hits only `ActionEngine.ts` (declaration, private map) and `packages/qa/dogfood/test/organization-rename-door.dogfood.test.ts`, which declares its own `interface RegisteredAction` at line 35 and imports only vitest, `@objectstack/verify` and a local boot helper. `git grep -w deepFreeze origin/main -- .` hits `freeze-schema.ts` plus four local `function deepFreeze` declarations (plugin-security `rls-boolean-comparand-door.test.ts`, service-analytics `native-sql-boolean-comparand-door.test.ts` and `native-sql-number-comparand-door.test.ts`, spec `filter-lowering.test.ts`) and `var deepFreeze` inside the sandbox source string of `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`. No `import` statement anywhere in the tree names either identifier. hotcrm: 0 hits for both, and hotcrm imports nothing from `@object-ui/core` at all. No pending `.changeset/*` names either. No other open PR touches the core barrel.
- **Keep rule 3 (a kept export's signature reaches the name) — does not hold for either, right.** `ActionEngine`'s only use of `RegisteredAction` is the `private actions` map; every public method takes or returns `ActionDef`, `ActionContext`, `ActionResult`, `ActionLocation`, `ShortcutBinding` or an inline literal type, and a private property is emitted in the `.d.ts` without its type, so the published declaration never reaches `RegisteredAction`. `deepFreeze` is called inside `defineSystemView` and typed through `DeepReadonly`, which stays exported; no kept signature names it.
- **Not taught — right.** Neither name appears in `ui/packages/core/README.md` (which teaches `defineSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride`, `isSystemView`, all kept), in `content/docs/**`, `skills/**` or `docs/**` other than the archived homonym hits above. `Skills-docs: none` on the PR body is true of the tree.
- **In-package readers keep working — right.** `defineSystemView` calls `deepFreeze` in the same module; `ActionEngine` types its map in the same module; the one core test touching freeze-schema imports it by module path, not through the barrel.
- **Check-runs on `dddbca3f` at 2026-11-08T03:31Z: 18 success, 11 skipped, 23 in progress.** Success includes `Check Changeset` (which runs `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test` and `--base MERGE_BASE`), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build UI Deps`, `Check PR Size`. Still in progress: `Build & E2E UI`, `Lint UI`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Test UI (1–16/16)`, `Type Check UI`, `Type Check · consumer gates` (the job that carries `check:published-readme-exports`, continue-on-error; the README was read by hand above and names neither retired export). The skipped runs are opt-in or push-only shapes. This record does not wait on the 23; their conclusions are the gate verdicts when they land.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/25921-core-homonym-only-exports.md`: `'@object-ui/core': patch`, title `refactor(core)!: …`, a **BREAKING** paragraph naming both names and the host they break, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, one `adr-0087: not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/core#RegisteredAction, @object-ui/core#deepFreeze) …` marker, and two `- FROM \`name\` TO …` lines — FROM spans 1:1 with the two marker operands. Matches what the diff publishes: a non-protocol breaking narrowing of a published entry ships `patch` with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition (AGENTS.md §changesets; the same shape as the nineteen earlier `25921-*` changesets on `main`, e.g. `25921-core-zero-consumer-exports.md`). `Metadata-protocol: none` is true: no `packages/spec` schema, node type or stored shape names either operand (grep above). `check-changeset-no-major` is satisfied by construction (`patch`).
- `Clause-②:` line: `no (narrowing)` at the start of a line on the PR body and in the changeset, read the same — the narrowing face, served here at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Correct: nothing in the diff is a published schema or a governed path.
- The changeset's "stays exported unchanged" sentence names `ActionEngine`, `ShortcutBinding`, `ActionLocation`, `ACTION_LOCATIONS`, `defineSystemView`, `isSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride`, `SYSTEM_VIEW_MARKER`, `SystemView`, `DeepReadonly`, `DeepMutable` — all eleven are in the two named lists; the sentence is true of the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6716702289 (2026-11-08T03:26Z): `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`. Two process deviations (no assignees on pr_create; shared checkout detached for the worktree) touch no file in the tree — noted, nothing to answer here.
- PR-body flag "external npm hosts importing either name will fail to compile (未实测)": answered by the card's rules and the seat's size ruling in amendment 6716057610 (startup-stage axis retires zero-consumer published names now); the changeset carries the BREAKING banner and a FROM/TO for each, which is the card's accepted remedy. Not escalated.
- PR-body flag "`pnpm check:published-readme-exports` not run locally": the CI job that runs it is in progress; this review read the README directly and it names neither retired export, so the gate cannot fail on this diff for the retired names.
- Amendment's hold-outs (`hasConflictingColumnIdentity`, `evaluatePlainCondition`, `meetsContrastLevel` stay because prose counts): the diff retires neither of the three — verified, the two lists drop only the two named. `isSystemView`, the four error classes and `defaultObjectValidationEngine` the claim fences stay exported.
- No dev flag asks for a ruling; nothing to escalate.

### ④ Design judgment

Read against the published spec on `main`: the core README (System Views section teaches `defineSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride`, `isSystemView`, with "deep-freeze" named only as what `defineSystemView` does), `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` and the rest of `content/docs` (which document `engine.registerAction` and action schemas, never a registry-entry type), and the two cited modules in the live tree.

- **Does the narrowing take a declared capability away at the consumer?** No. `RegisteredAction` is the shape of a private map; no public `ActionEngine` method ever exposed it, so no consumer could have obtained a value of that type from the entry — the only thing a host could do with the export was name a type nothing hands it. `deepFreeze` is an implementation step of the documented `defineSystemView` contract; the README never teaches freezing arbitrary objects through core, and the one documented path (System Views) stays whole: marker, freeze, `isSystemView`, `cloneAsOverride`, and the `DeepReadonly`/`DeepMutable`/`SystemView` types that make the frozen shape expressible.
- **Does it make the spec's own refusal real?** Partly, and in the right direction: the freeze-schema header says a System View is produced by `defineSystemView()`; a host that called `deepFreeze` directly got a frozen object without the marker, which `isSystemView` then refused — a half-state the module's own design does not want. Taking `deepFreeze` off the entry leaves `defineSystemView` as the one documented way, which is the spec's intent.
- **Implementation gap check (declared and not delivered, which must never be narrowed at the consumer):** neither name is declared anywhere a consumer reads (README, docs, spec, skills). This is surface, not capability, so the "retire or implement, never narrow at the consumer" rule has nothing to bite on.
- **Break attempts:** (a) a sibling `@object-ui/*` package re-exporting core wholesale — none exists; (b) a subpath still carrying the names — core publishes `.` only; (c) a second `export *` reaching the same module — none in `src/index.ts` or any sub-barrel; (d) an in-package reader importing through the barrel — none (grep); (e) duplicate-name shadowing by the new explicit exports — `ACTION_LOCATIONS`/`ActionLocation` were already surfaced by the prior star line from the same binding, and `Type Check · workspace` is green on the head; (f) the `.d.ts` leaking the private member's type — TypeScript emits `private actions;` without a type, so the declaration walk the dev reports is consistent with the compiler's rule.
- **Should-fix (not blocking):** none found that the tree needs. One editorial observation, below threshold for a finding: the changeset's TO for `RegisteredAction` ("the host's own type") prescribes no operand, which is correct for a type that had no obtainable value and matches the retirement arm the ADR-0087 gate reads (TO sides are not read for `runtime-export-retired`); `Check Changeset` is green on it.
- **Must-fix:** none.
